answer: A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The basalt counter is kept in sable and harbor reveals each reset. Someone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 822 identities would post 2985 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
